title: xtask: 'apps speak the kit' check
description: New cargo xtask ci step, same shape as no_hardcoded_hues: grep apps/*/src for raw button/input/select/textarea/h1-h4 and anchors carrying class, excluding lines marked isa-raw-ok. Add a row to the CONTRIBUTING.md rules table. Lands last so the gate is green on arrival.
acceptance_criteria: Step runs in cargo xtask ci, prints clean; a planted raw button fails it.

title: New instructions: TextLink (+ TEXT_LINK const) and bare Input
description: Raw underlined anchors in hiring/results.rs; four raw inputs (web main.rs:433,446 drop the focus ring; hiring rail.rs:301, lib.rs:235). Add TextLink { href, external } and pub const TEXT_LINK for router Links (kit has no router). Add Input (bare control with FIELD_BASE, forwards onfocusin/oninput/name/autocomplete); TextField and TextArea wrap it so FIELD_BASE has one home.
acceptance_criteria: FIELD_BASE used only inside Input; SSR test renders TextLink external with rel=noopener noreferrer. `cargo xtask ci` passes; every changed view opened with `dx serve` and checked by eye (CLAUDE.md: the gate does not render a page).

title: Kit composites are built from kit atoms

Rewrite them on Eyebrow/Heading/Card/Container. Settle Card padding as an operand if two values are genuinely needed (UI8: two call sites).
acceptance_criteria: site.rs contains no copy of an atom's class string; apps/web home looks the same. `cargo xtask ci` passes; every changed view opened with `dx serve` and checked by eye (CLAUDE.md: the gate does not render a page).

title: Button operands: Variant::Outline, Variant::Link, Size::Small
description: Seven hand-styled outline buttons/anchors (web main.rs:466,542,557; hiring results.rs:170,278,431) and two buttons styled as text links (hiring rail.rs:414, dashboard.rs:96). Add the operands to primitives.rs; extend every_variant_has_distinct_classes and every_size_has_distinct_classes.

title: Default --rv2-shell-* and --rv2-command-* hooks to registers
description: product-shell.css and command-select.css hard-code their own palettes and no app here sets them, so one page shows three focus colours (#0f172a, #2347c6, #315bc4) and CommandSelect is a cream box on hiring's dark theme. Keep the hooks (downstream bets theme through them — product-shell.md, command-select design doc) but default them: --rv2-shell-ink: var(--color-ink, #172033). Keep the hex as fallback for consumers without the theme. highlight/accent-soft/shadow have no register: leave as hex. DECISION NEEDED from the user: the header accent changes from blue #3156d9 to the theme's accent in app/web — accept, or add a brand register.
acceptance_criteria: One focus colour per app; CommandSelect readable on hiring; docs updated; user signed off on the header colour. `cargo xtask ci` passes; every changed view opened with `dx serve` and checked by eye (CLAUDE.md: the gate does not render a page).

title: Move the shared @theme into crates/rv2-ui/assets/theme.css
description: apps/app and apps/web carry byte-identical @theme blocks; apps/hiring repeats the full set to change values. Create crates/rv2-ui/assets/theme.css holding every register the kit uses, the registry aliases, and --font-display (default = --font-sans). app/web @import it and delete their copies. hiring imports it and keeps only value overrides plus its product registers (index-*, rust-*, clears-*). apps/hiring/tests/tokens.rs reads assets/input.css only — it must read the base too or it fails/passes for the wrong reason. Update the 'Changing it' paragraph in docs/design-system/ledger.md.
acceptance_criteria: Compiled app/web tailwind.css unchanged in rendered result; hiring renders identically; tokens.rs checks the merged theme. `cargo xtask ci` passes; every changed view opened with `dx serve` and checked by eye (CLAUDE.md: the gate does not render a page).
close_reason: crates/rv2-ui/assets/theme.css holds every register + registry aliases + --font-display/--font-weight-heading. app/web import it (compiled CSS byte-identical for app; same declarations reordered for web); hiring overrides values only. tokens.rs reads shared+own theme and asserts the import. ledger.md updated.

title: UI semantic ISA: one vocabulary for rv2-ui and its apps
description: Implement docs/architecture/003-ui-semantic-isa.md (UI1–UI9). Apps state intent through registers (tokens), operands (enums) and instructions (components); rv2-ui is the only place that emits classes. Children are ordered by dependency: foundations, then operands/instructions, then composites, then app migrations, then the xtask rule that locks it in.
acceptance_criteria: All children closed; 003 marked Accepted; `cargo xtask ci` enforces UI7.

title: Docs: accept 003 and correct stale kit claims
description: Mark 003 Accepted. rv2-ui lib.rs says 'no modal, tab, tooltip' (Tabs exists) and 'everything here is used by an app' (CommandSelect's consumer is external — name it). Append a dated note to docs/ledger/component-kit-autoresearch.md (29 components / light-mode only no longer hold) rather than rewriting history.
acceptance_criteria: No doc contradicts the code or 003.

title: Badge: a fill operand instead of colour-by-class
description: hiring passes colour through class (Badge { class: "bg-rust-strong text-rust-ink" }, PASSES const), which wins or loses against Badge's own bg-raised text-ink by stylesheet order.
